data.body: **[P2] Add a write path for callback-result offloading.** Wiring the offloader into deserialization does not offload callback results: the external producer submits the result directly to the callback API, and this operation never calls `offload`. Consequently large callback results still remain inline despite the new configuration and documentation. Provide a supported producer-side encoder based on callback identity, or remove callback results from the advertised offloading surfaces.
